_note: 联系页（contact.html）的内容。registry 里本页的 purpose 是「把问题路由到对的团队，而不是全部塞进同一个收件箱」，所以 routes 块是主角。公司地址 / 邮箱 / 电话 / 响应时间一条真实数据都没有 —— facts 块里 value 留空会渲染成「Not published yet」，不要编。真实资料到位后只填 value，不用动代码。
description: Where each kind of question goes: quotes, technical support, documents, samples and partnership — plus what is not published yet.
lead: One page that sends your question to the right route instead of one general inbox.

blocks.heading: Where your question goes
blocks.note: Each route has its own form and its own fields. Picking the right one is the difference between one round trip and four.

items.label: Product quote or pricing
items.note: Reference prices, quantity breaks, lead time and freight.

items.label: Technical support
items.note: Wiring, pairing, firmware and published documents.

items.label: Documents and downloads
items.note: Datasheets, manuals, wiring diagrams and certificates.

items.label: Samples
items.note: Evaluation units before a first order.

blocks.heading: Company and response details
blocks.note: These are published only when they are confirmed. Nothing here is filled in with a placeholder number or a plausible-looking address.

blocks.heading: Until the direct details are published
paragraphs: The enquiry form is the route that works today. It builds a summary you can send on, and it carries the model, configuration and quantity a quote actually needs.
If your question is technical rather than commercial, use the support route instead — it does not ask you for purchase quantities.

items.label: Factory visit arrangements
items.note: How to book a visit, what a visit covers, and which sites can host one.

items.label: Regional contacts
items.note: Whether there are regional offices or representatives, and which markets they cover.
